learning_outcomes.text: Identify the objects from the pictorial drawings and draws the principal views.
Comprehends the conventional drawings for the features such as holes, counterbores, fillets-rounds / their intersections, etc. and applies them.
Understands parts from existing principal view(s) and draws other view(s).
Makes dimensioning of the views of the objects.
Makes the isometric and oblique drawings of the objects.
Knows the sectioning methods and applies them.
Knows CAD software and makes drawings by using it.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to technical drawing: Basic concepts
Geometric constructions. AutoCAD basic commands and applications
Principles of orthographic projection: Basic projections of parts, selection of views. Freehand drawing practices.
Drawing of six principal views of objects whose pictorial drawings are given. AutoCAD basic commands and applications.
Drawing of six principal views of objects whose pictorial drawings are given. AutoCAD applications.
Conventional drawings of the features such as holes, counterbores, fillets-rounds / their intersections, etc. AutoCAD applications.
Drawing the missing view(s) of the parts by making use of the given principal view(s). AutoCAD applications.
Three dimensional drawing techniques: Isometric drawing. AutoCAD applications
Three dimensional drawing techniques: Oblique drawing. AutoCAD applications.
Principles of sectioning: Full, offset and half sections. AutoCAD applications
Principles of sectioning: Aligned sections, revolved/ removed sections, broken-out sections and related conventions. AutoCAD applications.
Principles of sectioning: Aligned sections, revolved/ removed sections, broken-out sections and related conventions. AutoCAD applications
bibliography: Giesecke, Frederick E., et. al., Technical Drawing with Engineering Graphics (14th Edition), Prentice-Hall, 2010.
